Job Summary

Responsible for forecasting and managing the operating and capital budget of the mining operation, and for monitoring and controlling actual cost performance against plan. The role provides accurate cost estimates and validation to support tender and bid submissions, ensures spending is well controlled and compliant with company policies, and drives cost efficiency and financial discipline so that the business delivers its production targets at the optimum cost.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead annual OPEX and CAPEX budgeting for mining operations, consolidating cross-functional inputs and aligning budgets with production plans, cost drivers and business assumptions.
• Monitor and control expenditure against approved budgets and forecasts, reviewing commitments, identifying variances and driving timely corrective actions.
• Develop periodic forecasts, cost projections and scenario analyses based on production volume, fuel prices, equipment performance and other key variables.
• Analyse cost performance and unit costs (e.g., cost/tonne, cost/BCM, equipment operating costs), identify root causes and provide management with actionable insights and dashboards.
• Support tenders and bids through cost estimation, modelling and pricing validation, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness and alignment with margin and risk parameters.
• Drive cost efficiency and financial discipline through savings initiatives, policy compliance, internal controls, and effective leadership and development of the cost control and budget team.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Mining Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Accounting, Finance or Economics. Master's Degree or MBA is an advantage.

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Minimum 10 years of experience in mining, heavy equipment or related industries.
• Strong understanding of mining operational cost structure.
• Budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling.
• Cost accounting, CAPEX and OPEX management.
• ERP systems (SAP preferred), advanced Excel and Power BI.
• Strong analytical, problem solving and business acumen.
• Fluent in English, spoken and written.

Certification

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
